source_caption:
🎬 Mechanic: Resurrection (2016)

Mechanic: Resurrection follows Arthur Bishop, a highly skilled assassin who has left his dangerous past behind and is living quietly under a new identity. However, his peaceful life comes to an end when a ruthless criminal mastermind kidnaps Gina, a woman he has fallen in love with, and forces him to return to his deadly profession. To save her, Bishop must complete three seemingly impossible assassinations across different countries, making each death appear to be an accident. As he travels through dangerous locations, confronts powerful enemies, and executes elaborate missions, Bishop discovers that his enemies have underestimated his intelligence and determination. Starring Jason Statham, Jessica Alba, and Tommy Lee Jones, Mechanic: Resurrection delivers explosive action, intense fight sequences, and thrilling suspense while exploring revenge, loyalty, survival, and the lengths someone will go to protect the person they love.

🎭 Genre: Action • Crime • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 5.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 38m • R

🎥 Director: Dennis Gansel

✍️ Writers: Philip Shelby & Tony Mosher

source_details.synopsis: Mechanic: Resurrection is a 2016 American action thriller film directed by Dennis Gansel and written by Philip Shelby and Tony Mosher, with a story by Shelby and Brian Pittman. It is the sequel to the 2011 film The Mechanic, which was a remake of the 1972 film of the same name. The film stars Jason Statham, Tommy Lee Jones, Jessica Alba, and Michelle Yeoh. Mechanic: Resurrection premiered in Hollywood on August 22, 2016, and was theatrically released in the United States on August 26, 2016. It received generally negative reviews from critics, but grossed $125 million worldwide against a budget of $40 million, eclipsing the total of its predecessor.
